name: navbar-mobile
title: Navbar Mobile Menu
description: Top bar that folds into a menu button on narrow containers, with focus moved into the open menu, a Tab loop and Escape to close.

props.name: links
props.type: { label: string; href: string; current?: boolean }[]
props.description: Links, shown inline on wide containers and in the menu on narrow ones.

props.name: action
props.description: Call to action, inline or at the end of the menu.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the nav landmark.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the menu takes to slide open.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
